scope: one-function exploratory pilot; do not expand benchmark automatically
primary_contrast: verified vs extracted with identical candidate pool and order
pilot_inference: descriptive paired observations only; no generalization CI or p-value
independent_unit_for_future_confirmation: held-out target function; cluster by project
missing_values: NA; distinguish infrastructure failures and no generated tests
mutation_rule: only original-passing tests; same mutant pool; inconclusive prevents point score
same_selected_setup: report all and stratify; never discard as inconvenient
forbidden_claims_at_current_stage: statistical significance from repeated greedy runs of one function
high mutation effectiveness inferred from the internal oracle
measured human effort savings without a user study
